translated_title: Le Pen Is Misinformed, Sheinbaum Says; "The 'Mexicanization' Is the Honesty and Solidarity of the People," She Asserts
original_title: Le Pen está malinformada, dice Sheinbaum; "la 'mexicanización' es la honestidad y solidaridad del pueblo", asegura
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Alonso Urrutia
meta_description: The French far-right leader vowed to stop the "Mexicanization" of France. Asked about Flávio Bolsonaro fleeing to the US, Sheinbaum said: "It explains itself."
